title: Inbox / reply_to — disconnect-safe initiator pattern
description: The initiator sends an intent with reply_to pointing to its own inbox address. The agent processes the intent (stream binding). When COMPLETED, AXME delivers the result to the initiator's reply_to inbox. The initiator can disconnect and read the result later — no persistent connection required.

agents.description: step 1/1 — stream: validates order, computes tracking ID, delivers result to initiator inbox

intent._note: reply_to is injected by runner from initiator's SA address
